preconditions.description: The input must be an array of exactly two elements.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(bear, str) for bear in bears)
preconditions.description: Both elements in the input array must be strings.
Both elements in the input array must be valid bear colors.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the specified bear fur colors or 'unknown'.
If both bears are black, the offspring must be black.
If both bears are brown, the offspring must be brown.
If both bears are white, the offspring must be white.
If one bear is black and the other is brown, the offspring must be dark brown.
If one bear is black and the other is white, the offspring must be grey.
If one bear is brown and the other is white, the offspring must be light brown.

postconditions.expression: any(bear not in ['black', 'brown', 'white'] for bear in bears) == (stdout == 'unknown')
postconditions.description: If either bear is not a valid color, the offspring must be unknown.
